fun_facts: Alvin Kamara was born in Atlanta, Georgia.
Before Tennessee, Alvin Kamara spent a year at Hutchinson Community College in Kansas.
Alvin Kamara scored six rushing touchdowns against the Vikings in one game, tying the NFL record for most rushing touchdowns in a game.
After his rookie season, Alvin Kamara won the AP Offensive Rookie of the Year award.
By 2023, Alvin Kamara was the Saints' career touchdown leader, with 73 touchdowns for the team.

basis.reasoning: ESPN's biography lists Tennessee as Kamara's college. ESPN's career account says he spent a year at Hutchinson Community College before transferring to Tennessee, supporting Tennessee as his last college.
